description: Multi-Temporal Flood Susceptibility Mapping Using Sentinel-1 SAR Time-Series and Machine Learning: Case Study of Sebkhet Ariana (NE Tunisia) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Zenodo. Python script used for multi-temporal flood mapping and flood susceptibility assessment of Sebkhet Ariana, Tunisia, based on Sentinel-1 SAR data, environmental conditioning factors, and Random Forest modelling for the 2019–2024 period. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Zenodo. Its tags are Flood susceptibility mapping, Sentinel-1 SAR time series, Random Forest, Flood recurrence, Coastal wetlands. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
